premises.text: Antimicrobial resistance is a top global health threat
premises.evidence_span: The World Health Organization says that antimicrobial resistance is a top 10 global health threat in the world facing humanity.

premises.text: Phage therapy can be a precise alternative to antibiotics
premises.evidence_span: Phages are microbes that infect bacteria. You can think of them like antibiotics, except they're natural and they're precise.

premises.text: A testing platform is necessary to identify the right phage treatment for patients
premises.evidence_span: we recognized was that if we were going to bring a precision serum or solution to market, we better have a test.

premises.text: Whole genome sequencing provides comprehensive data on the skin microbiome
premises.evidence_span: we use a more advanced technology called whole genome sequencing.

premises.text: Parallel has developed a skin microbiome discovery kit with multiple swabs
premises.evidence_span: we have four swabs in the kit.

premises.text: Parallel can produce phages at high titer for efficacy
premises.evidence_span: we use bioreactors to produce and scale phages at extremely high titer.

value.text: Patients can receive personalized phage treatments based on their skin microbiome
value.evidence_span: recommendations on food ingredients, skin care ingredients, as well as her phage serum that's right for her.
